```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {
  toRows, presetRange, PRESETS, effectiveStart, anchorAndIndex, colorFor,
  formatEndLabel, yDomain, declutterValues, canSelect
} from "./js/series.js"

registry = (await fetch("data/series.json")).json()
registryIndex = new Map(registry.map((s, i) => [s.id, i]))
// Rate series join with their own panel in phase 6.
pickable = registry.filter((s) => s.kind === "level")
DEFAULT_SELECTION = ["sp500", "nasdaq"]
DEFAULT_PRESET = "10Y"
```

::: {.panel-sidebar}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected = {
  const form = html`<div class="picker"></div>`;
  form.value = DEFAULT_SELECTION.filter((id) => pickable.some((s) => s.id === id));
  const boxes = new Map();
  const update = () => {
    for (const [id, box] of boxes) {
      box.checked = form.value.includes(id);
      box.disabled = !canSelect(form.value, id);
    }
  };
  const emit = () => {
    update();
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  for (const category of [...new Set(pickable.map((s) => s.category))]) {
    const group = html`<fieldset class="picker-group"><legend>${category}</legend></fieldset>`;
    for (const s of pickable.filter((s) => s.category === category)) {
      const box = html`<input type="checkbox" value=${s.id}>`;
      box.onchange = () => {
        form.value = box.checked
          ? registry.map((r) => r.id).filter((id) => id === s.id || form.value.includes(id))
          : form.value.filter((id) => id !== s.id);
        emit();
      };
      boxes.set(s.id, box);
      group.append(html`<label class="picker-item">${box} ${s.name}</label>`);
    }
    form.append(group);
  }
  const clear = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Deselect All</button>`;
  clear.onclick = () => {
    form.value = [];
    emit();
  };
  form.append(clear);
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof range = {
  const form = html`<div class="range"><div class="range-label">Date range</div></div>`;
  const buttons = new Map();
  const bar = html`<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group"></div>`;
  const from = html`<input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm">`;
  const to = html`<input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm">`;
  const set = (value) => {
    form.value = value;
    from.value = value.from;
    to.value = value.to;
    for (const [p, b] of buttons) b.classList.toggle("active", p === value.preset);
  };
  const emit = () => form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  for (const preset of Object.keys(PRESETS)) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">${preset}</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      set({ ...presetRange(preset, registry), preset });
      emit();
    };
    buttons.set(preset, b);
    bar.append(b);
  }
  const edited = () => {
    if (!from.value || !to.value) return;
    set({ from: from.value, to: to.value, preset: null });
    emit();
  };
  from.onchange = edited;
  to.onchange = edited;
  form.append(
    bar,
    html`<label class="range-input">From ${from}</label>`,
    html`<label class="range-input">To ${to}</label>`
  );
  set({ ...presetRange(DEFAULT_PRESET, registry), preset: DEFAULT_PRESET });
  return form;
}
```

::: {.panel-fill}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
utc = (date) => new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`)
selectedMeta = registry.filter((s) => selected.includes(s.id))
loaded = Promise.all(selectedMeta.map(async (m) => (await fetch(`data/${m.id}.json`)).json()))
win = effectiveStart(range.from, selectedMeta)
indexed = loaded.map((series) => ({ series, result: anchorAndIndex(series, win.start, range.to) }))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (selected.length === 0) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">Select at least one series</p>`;
  }
  if (win.start > range.to) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">${
      win.mover
        ? `The window ends before ${win.mover.name}'s data begins on ${win.mover.first_date}. Choose a later To date.`
        : `The window ends before it starts on ${win.start}. Choose a later To date.`
    }</p>`;
  }

  const shown = indexed.filter((d) => d.result);
  const leftOut = indexed.filter((d) => !d.result).map((d) => d.series.name);
  const note = leftOut.length
    ? html`<p class="chart-note">Left out (no data within 180 days of ${win.start}): ${leftOut.join(", ")}</p>`
    : "";
  const header = html`<div class="chart-header">
    <h2 class="chart-title">Indexed performance since ${win.start}</h2>
    <p class="chart-subtitle">100 = value on ${win.start}${
      win.mover ? `. Window starts ${win.start}, when ${win.mover.name} data begins` : ""
    }</p>
  </div>`;
  if (shown.length === 0) return html`${header}${note}`;

  const height = 480;
  const marginTop = 20;
  const marginBottom = 30;
  const marginRight = 170;
  const rows = shown.flatMap(({ series, result }) =>
    result.points.map((p) => ({
      id: series.id, name: series.name, day: p.date, date: utc(p.date),
      value: p.value, plotted: p.plotted
    }))
  );
  const domain = yDomain(rows.map((r) => r.plotted), 100);
  const ends = shown.map(({ series, result }) => {
    const last = result.points[result.points.length - 1];
    return { id: series.id, date: utc(last.date), plotted: last.plotted, label: formatEndLabel(series.name, last.plotted) };
  });
  const labelY = declutterValues(ends.map((e) => e.plotted), domain, {
    top: marginTop, bottom: height - marginBottom, gap: 14
  });
  ends.forEach((e, i) => (e.labelY = labelY[i]));
  const ids = shown.map(({ series }) => series.id);

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width, height, marginTop, marginBottom, marginRight,
    x: { type: "utc", domain: [utc(win.start), utc(range.to)], label: null },
    y: { domain, nice: false, grid: true, label: "Index, start = 100" },
    color: { domain: ids, range: ids.map((id) => colorFor(registryIndex.get(id))) },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleY([100], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.4 }),
      Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "plotted", z: "id", stroke: "id", strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      Plot.text(ends, {
        x: "date", y: "labelY", text: "label", fill: "id",
        textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, clip: false
      }),
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({
        x: "date", y: "plotted", stroke: "id",
        channels: { Series: "name", Date: "day", Index: "plotted", Value: "value" },
        format: { x: false, y: false, stroke: false, Index: (v) => v.toFixed(1) }
      }))
    ]
  });
  return html`${header}${chart}${note}`;
}
```
